title: False Beacons on the Sea of Ghosts

hook.rumour: Fishermen at Dagon Fel's End of the World tavern swear someone is lighting false storm-lanterns on the basalt skerries to lure cogs onto the rocks while blaming the Urshilaku hunters.
hook.notice: DAGON FEL HARBOUR WATCH — Reward posted for uncovering who tends the false wrecking-fires between Dagon Fel, Sanctus Shrine, and Vas.
hook.context: Sheogorad's jagged islands shelter a stubborn mix of Nord whalers, Dunmer hermits, and silent Temple pilgrims; when ships break on the reefs, old suspicions flare fast.

stages.objective: Inspect the salvaged rudder and whale-oil casks on the quay at Dagon Fel
Speak with the vowed hermit at Sanctus Shrine regarding the night-signals on the western rocks
Compare the Ashlander coast-patrol reports at Urshilaku Camp

objectives.text: Inspect the salvaged rudder and whale-oil casks on the quay at Dagon Fel
Speak with the vowed hermit at Sanctus Shrine regarding the night-signals on the western rocks
Compare the Ashlander coast-patrol reports at Urshilaku Camp

consequence_detail.summary: The Sanctus Shrine hermit and Urshilaku scouts prove the wrecking-lanterns burn refined pitch brought from the old towers near Vas.

stages.objective: Search the cliff-top gallery at Sulipund for the brass signal-mirror
Defeat the wrecker lookouts camped in the stronghold ruins of Valenvaryon
Inspect the hidden boat-landing beneath the tower of Ald Redaynia

objectives.text: Search the cliff-top gallery at Sulipund for the brass signal-mirror
Defeat the wrecker lookouts camped in the stronghold ruins of Valenvaryon
Inspect the hidden boat-landing beneath the tower of Ald Redaynia

consequence_detail.summary: The brass signal-mirror and boat-landing logs show the wreckers haul their plunder into the island fortress of Vas and Addadshashanammu.

stages.objective: Storm the Daedric island tower of Vas and break the wrecker captain's coven
Smash the false beacon-brazier atop the shrine of Addadshashanammu
Recover the stolen Dagon Fel harbour-bell from the cavern cache at Shushishi

objectives.text: Storm the Daedric island tower of Vas and break the wrecker captain's coven
Smash the false beacon-brazier atop the shrine of Addadshashanammu
Recover the stolen Dagon Fel harbour-bell from the cavern cache at Shushishi

consequence_detail.summary: The wrecker coven at Vas is broken, the false brazier at Addadshashanammu is dark, and Dagon Fel's harbour-bell is recovered.

quests.title: True Light on the Northern Watchtower

stages.objective: Have the recovered harbour-bell blessed in silence at Sanctus Shrine
Rehang the harbour-bell and light the true sea-beacon at Dagon Fel
Share the peace-feast between the Nord whalers and Dunmer scouts at Dagon Fel

objectives.text: Have the recovered harbour-bell blessed in silence at Sanctus Shrine
Rehang the harbour-bell and light the true sea-beacon at Dagon Fel
Share the peace-feast between the Nord whalers and Dunmer scouts at Dagon Fel

consequence_detail.summary: The true beacon shines over Dagon Fel, ships pass the Sheogorad reefs safely, and peace holds between the village and the Urshilaku.
